description: A stroke layer keeps editable strokes: list, find, change, reorder, remove, convert and rasterize.

skip.swift: The Swift paint editor is not ported yet (#540).

error.message: Layer "Lines" already has paint, which isn't kept as strokes; convert an empty layer or add a stroke layer (add_layer {type: "strokes"}).
Pass at least one change: brushId, brush, color, paint or seed.
